papers.title: Non-Stationary Gaussian Process Regression with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: We present a novel approach for fully non-stationary Gaussian process regression (GPR), where all three key parameters -- noise variance, signal variance and lengthscale -- can be simultaneously input-dependent. We develop gradient-based inference methods to learn the unknown function and the non-stationary model parameters, without requiring any model approximations. We propose to infer full parameter posterior with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC), which conveniently extends the analytical gradient-based GPR learning by guiding the sampling with model gradients. We also learn the MAP solution from the posterior by gradient ascent. In experiments on several synthetic datasets and in modelling of temporal gene expression, the nonstationary GPR is shown to be necessary for modeling realistic input-dependent dynamics, while it performs comparably to conventional stationary or previous non-stationary GPR models otherwise.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法适用于构建非平稳高斯过程代理模型，可迁移至植入物设计的有限元替代建模，但未针对力学约束或优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: No application to FEA or biomechanics, no constraint handling, no implant-related validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准高斯过程回归假设平稳性，无法建模输入依赖的动态变化。
summary_zh.method: 提出完全非平稳高斯过程，所有参数均可输入相关，并采用哈密顿蒙特卡洛推断全参数后验。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据和基因表达数据上，非平稳模型优于或持平于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 合成数据集和时序基因表达数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian process regression assumes stationarity, which fails to capture input-dependent dynamics in many real-world processes.
summary_en.method: A fully non-stationary Gaussian process regression is proposed where noise variance, signal variance, and lengthscale are input-dependent; inference is performed via Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with gradient guidance.
summary_en.result: On synthetic datasets and temporal gene expression data, the non-stationary model outperforms or matches conventional stationary and previous non-stationary models.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic datasets and real temporal gene expression data.

papers.title: Integrated fabrication-conjugation approaches for biomolecular assembly and protein sensing with hybrid microparticle platforms and biofabrication - A focused minireview
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering, Tufts University, 4 Colby St., Medford, MA, 02155, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Sukwon Jung
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering, Tufts University, 4 Colby St., Medford, MA, 02155, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了生物制造中的集成方法，但未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on fabrication-conjugation approaches without any AI integration, experimental validation, or autonomous decision-making relevant to AI for bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述用于生物分子组装和蛋白质传感的混合微粒子平台与生物制造方法。
summary_zh.method: 通过文献回顾，总结集成制造-偶联策略。
summary_zh.result: 概述了不同平台的构建原理及其在生物传感中的应用。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为纯文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes integrated fabrication-conjugation approaches for biomolecular assembly and protein sensing using hybrid microparticle platforms.
summary_en.method: The review categorizes and describes various strategies that combine fabrication and conjugation techniques.
summary_en.result: It provides an overview of platform types and their applications in biosensing.
summary_en.validation: No validation is provided as this is a literature review.
